definitions.gloss: in the dark; in darkness; in secret
definitions.explanation: The state of being in darkness, used both literally and figuratively for situations where one cannot see the way ahead. Formed from {暗|あん} (dark) and {中|ちゅう} (within). Largely confined to set expressions and written style.

examples.japanese: {暗中|あんちゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手探|てさぐ}り→手探り：10564_tesaguri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: I grope my way forward in the dark.

examples.japanese: ⟦{解決策|かいけつさく}→解決策：19395_kaiketsusaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}え→見える：01165_mieru⟧ず、{暗中|あんちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{迷|まよ}っている→迷う：02426_mayou⟧ようだ。
examples.english: With no solution in sight, it feels like wandering in the dark.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新規事業|しんきじぎょう}→新規事業：17985_shinkijigyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{前例|ぜんれい}→前例：11790_zenrei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦{暗中模索|あんちゅうもさく}→暗中模索：06458_anchuumosaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The new business had no precedent, so a state of groping in the dark continued.

notes:
A literary, written-style word that rarely stands alone in everyday speech. It appears mainly in fixed four-character expressions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{暗中模索|あんちゅうもさく}→暗中模索：06458_anchuumosaku⟧: groping in the dark; trial and error
- {暗中飛躍|あんちゅうひやく}: working behind the scenes; secret maneuvering

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{闇|やみ}→闇：14528_yami⟧: darkness — the everyday word for physical or figurative darkness.
- ⟦{暗闇|くらやみ}→暗闇：12859_kurayami⟧: the dark; pitch darkness — concrete and far more common in conversation.
